properties-fact-strategies-skill-01.target: I can use the commutative property to turn an array or fact around and know the product stays the same.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use the commutative property to turn an array or fact around and know the product stays the same.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Believing the property works for division too (12 ÷ 3 = 3 ÷ 12). Try this: Rotate an array a quarter turn: rows become columns, the total does not change. Test a division example to see it fail.

properties-fact-strategies-skill-02.target: I can regroup three factors to make multiplying easier and show the product is the same.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can regroup three factors to make multiplying easier and show the product is the same.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Multiplying only two of the three factors, or adding one of them. Try this: Circle the two factors you will multiply first, write the partial product, then multiply by the third.

properties-fact-strategies-skill-03.target: I can break a factor into two easier parts, multiply each part, and add the two products.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can break a factor into two easier parts, multiply each part, and add the two products.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Breaking apart one factor but multiplying only one part, or adding the leftover part instead of multiplying it. Try this: Draw the array and split it with a line; label each part with its own multiplication.

properties-fact-strategies-skill-04.target: I can explain and use the rules for multiplying by 0 and 1 and dividing by 1 and by the same number.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can explain and use the rules for multiplying by 0 and 1 and dividing by 1 and by the same number.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking n × 0 = n, or that 0 ÷ n and n ÷ 0 behave the same. Try this: Tell equal-group stories: 5 plates with 0 cookies; 1 plate with 5 cookies. Explain why we cannot share into 0 groups.

properties-fact-strategies-skill-05.target: I can find any fact to 10 × 10 with a strategy such as doubling, adding a group, or subtracting a group.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find any fact to 10 × 10 with a strategy such as doubling, adding a group, or subtracting a group.
properties-fact-strategies-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Making an off-by-one-group error (7 × 8 = 48) or using the strategy on the wrong fact. Try this: Name the known fact you start from and say how many groups you are adding or subtracting.
